artifact_publication_precision.name: artifact_publication_precision
artifact_publication_precision.value: ("artifact"."published_at" is null and "artifact"."published_precision" = 'absent') or ("artifact"."published_at" is not null and "artifact"."published_precision" in ('day','month','year'))

observation_review_replacement.name: observation_review_replacement
observation_review_replacement.value: ("observation_review"."decision" = 'rejected' and "observation_review"."replacement_observation_id" is null) or ("observation_review"."decision" in ('confirmed','corrected') and "observation_review"."replacement_observation_id" is not null and "observation_review"."replacement_observation_id" <> "observation_review"."observation_id")

relationship_dates.name: relationship_dates
relationship_dates.value: "relationship"."valid_from" is null or "relationship"."valid_to" is null or "relationship"."valid_from" <= "relationship"."valid_to"

processing_job_scope.name: processing_job_scope
processing_job_scope.value: ("processing_job"."kind" = 'parse' and "processing_job"."scope_key" = 'parse:snapshot:' || "processing_job"."snapshot_id"::text) or ("processing_job"."kind" in ('enrich','index') and "processing_job"."target_id" is not null and "processing_job"."scope_key" = "processing_job"."kind" || ':object:' || "processing_job"."target_id"::text)

processing_job_lease.name: processing_job_lease
processing_job_lease.value: ("processing_job"."state" = 'leased' and "processing_job"."lease_token" is not null and "processing_job"."leased_until" is not null) or ("processing_job"."state" <> 'leased' and "processing_job"."lease_token" is null and "processing_job"."leased_until" is null)

processing_run_finish.name: processing_run_finish
processing_run_finish.value: ("processing_run"."outcome" = 'running' and "processing_run"."finished_at" is null) or ("processing_run"."outcome" <> 'running' and "processing_run"."finished_at" is not null and "processing_run"."finished_at" >= "processing_run"."started_at")

walk_session_completion.name: walk_session_completion
walk_session_completion.value: "walk_session"."completed_at" is null or ("walk_session"."sealed_at" is not null and "walk_session"."completed_at" >= "walk_session"."sealed_at")
